book.title: Career and Technical Education Grade 7 Student Textbook
book.subject: cte
book.unit_title: Introduction to Career and Technical Education (CTE)

title: Importance of Career and Technical Education
competency: Describe the importance of Career and Technical Education.

keywords.def: Teaching skills-based careers to students. Short form: CTE.
Workers who have the skills to do a job well.
Learning by doing a real task with your hands.

en.text: CTE covers fields like agriculture, construction, pottery, leather, metal work, pharmacy, crafts, hotel service and business. It creates skilled workers, helps the economy and improves life. It links classroom learning to real problems, reduces unemployment, and is a base for further education.

screens.title: No work in town
screens.ask: Many young people in a town have no work. How could CTE help?
opts: By teaching skills people can use to get or create work
screens.after: CTE gives practical skills. Skills open job opportunities and reduce unemployment.

screens.title: 1.4 Importance of CTE
paras: CTE covers courses in agriculture, construction, pottery and leather processing.
It also covers metal work, pharmacy, crafts, hotel service and business.
It creates skilled manpower for the country.
It helps socioeconomic development and improves the quality of life.

screens.title: Ready for college and career
paras: CTE programs prepare students for college and careers.
They give technical training and hands-on learning experiences.
Students build skills that all employers value.

screens.title: Benefits of CTE
items: CTE links classroom learning with applied knowledge and skills.
It reduces the problem of unemployment.
It prepares for higher education and career growth.
It creates engaged workers ready for technical careers.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Workers who have the skills to do a job well.
Learning by doing a real task with your hands.

screens.text: Which is a benefit of CTE given in the book?
opts: It reduces the problem of unemployment
It removes the need for school
It makes all jobs the same
screens.ans: It reduces the problem of unemployment

screens.text: Tap every field that CTE covers.
screens.why: The book lists agriculture, construction, pottery, hotel service and more.
screens.clue: Which ones are skills for work?

screens.ask: ___ links school learning with the world of work.
screens.why: CTE connects classroom learning with real-world skills.
screens.clue: Which kind of education is this unit about?

screens.text: CTE focuses more on academic learning.
screens.why: CTE stresses technical, hands-on, career-oriented skills, combined with academic learning.
screens.clue: What does the "T" in CTE stand for?

screens.text: Does CTE contribute to individual development?
opts: No, it only helps the country
Yes, it gives skills, experience and job chances that help a person grow
screens.ans: Yes, it gives skills, experience and job chances that help a person grow
screens.why: CTE gives technical skills and hands-on experience, opens jobs and prepares for further study. So the person grows in skills and income.
screens.clue: Think about what CTE gives one student.

test.text: Which field is covered by CTE?
test.why: The book lists leather processing among CTE fields.

test.text: CTE creates skilled manpower for a country.
test.why: It plays a vital role in human resource development.
That is how CTE prepares students.

test.ask: CTE serves as a base for further ___ at a higher level.
test.why: It is a base for further education and career growth.

test.text: A student learns to fix bicycles in a CTE class and starts a small repair business. Which benefit does this show?
test.why: CTE skills open employment and self-employment.

notes.text: Activity 4 is open; used as the challenge with a book-based model answer.
